verdict.rationale: Alloy documents workflows, Journeys and scheduled Portfolio workflows, but nothing in the evidence shows workflow version history, change review or approval, or rollback to a prior workflow version. API endpoint versioning (/v1 and deprecation callouts) concerns the API surface, not users' automations. Sandbox mode is a per-request testing mode, not versioning or review. The 'fully auditable' marketing line does not describe versioning or rollback. All of these are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
